description.zh:
语言类型。系统权限策略的描述将以此语言返回。

- en：英文。
- zh-CN：中文。
- ja：日文。
description.en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the system policy. Valid values:

*   en: English
*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   ja: Japanese

description.zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短横线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-).

description.zh:
权限策略类型。取值为空表示列出所有类型的权限策略。

- Custom：自定义策略。
- System：系统策略。
description.en:
The type of the permission policy. If you do not configure this parameter, all types of policies are returned. Valid values:

*   Custom
*   System
The name of the object to which you want to attach the permission policy.

description.zh:
被授权对象类型。取值为空表示列出所有类型的被授权对象。

- IMSUser：RAM用户。
- IMSGroup：RAM用户组。
- ServiceRole：RAM角色。
description.en:
The type of the object to which you want to attach the permission policy. If you do not configure this parameter, the system lists all types of objects. Valid values:

*   IMSUser: RAM user
*   IMSGroup: RAM user group
*   ServiceRole: RAM role

description.zh: 资源组ID或资源组所属的阿里云账号ID。取值为空表示列出当前账号下的所有授权记录。
description.en: The ID of the resource group or the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource group belongs. If you do not configure this parameter, the system lists all policy attachment records within the current account.

descriptions.zh:
您可以查看以下信息：

- 阿里云账号或资源组下的所有授权记录。
- RAM用户、RAM用户组、RAM角色被授予的所有权限策略。
- 阿里云账号或资源组下拥有某个权限的RAM用户、RAM用户组、RAM角色。
descriptions.en:
You can view the following information:

*   Policy attachment records within an Alibaba Cloud account or a resource group
*   Permission policies attached to RAM users, RAM user groups, or RAM roles
*   RAM users, RAM user groups, or RAM roles to which permission policies are attached within an Alibaba Cloud account or a resource group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-policy-attachments --resource-group-id rg-001 --policy-type System --policy-name AdministratorAccess --principal-type IMSUser --principal-name alice@demo.onaliyun.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-language zh-CN --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListPolicyAttachments --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyType System --ResourceGroupId 'rg-001' --PageSize 10 --Language 'zh-CN' --PageNumber 1 --PolicyName AdministratorAccess --PrincipalName 'alice@demo.onaliyun.com' --PrincipalType IMSUser
